title: Glowing Emissive Ores Definitive Edition
description: Makes ores from over 250 mods and vanilla emissive!
body:
![Vanilla](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/43e462954e4d32dd862930f9f091a20fdf9cec81.webp)

### Overview
Makes ores from over 250 mods and vanilla emissive! Updates add additional mod support, requests are welcome :)

- Optimized to load only the assets needed for your installed mods, drastically reducing load times compared to resource pack equivalents. In my experience it's around 30 to 120 seconds faster: [Video Comparison](https://youtu.be/iRQeCUUSO58)
- In-game config for adjusting the brightness or disabling individual ores.
- No 3rd party emissive mod required

<details>
<summary>My vision</summary>

I plan to add support for as many mods as possible, so you can use it in almost all modpacks. I have designed this mod to be highly compatible with different mod versions.

If you notice any ores from the supported mods don't glow or use outdated textures, then please leave a comment with the mod name, mod loader and minecraft version you are using.

</details>

### Planned:

- Add support for more minecraft versions.
- And more...
